name: Classic Deep & Soulful House
description: Warm, soulful, and swinging deep house inspired by Larry Heard, Frankie Knuckles, and Kerri Chandler. Features classic Rhodes chords, warm FM bass, and 909/707 swing drums.

philosophy: Warmth, soul, and human swing: Deep house is about emotional chord progressions, warm analog saturation, and swing percentages of 58-62%.
The groove is in the bass and hi-hats: An infectious round bassline playing around the kick drum.
Lush chord voicings: Minor 7th, 9th, and 11th chords played with velocity sensitivity on vintage electric pianos.

sound_design.Warm Round Kick: Deep, pillowy 909 or 808 kick drum with soft tape saturation.
sound_design.Classic House Bass: Warm FM Lately Bass or Juno square bass. Melodic, walking or syncopated.
sound_design.Rhodes Chords: Electric piano / Rhodes routed through chorus and subtle spring reverb.
sound_design.909 Open Hat & Shaker: Lush swinging 909 open hats on the offbeat with 16th shaker loops for continuous momentum.

step_by_step_walkthrough.title: Dial in 124 BPM & House Swing
step_by_step_walkthrough.detail: Set project tempo to 124 BPM. Load swing grooves (MPC 16 Swing 58%) on all percussion.

step_by_step_walkthrough.title: Lay Down the Chord Progression
step_by_step_walkthrough.detail: Play or program a 4-chord soulful minor progression using electric piano or warm pads.

step_by_step_walkthrough.title: Formulate the Melodic Bassline
step_by_step_walkthrough.detail: Write a warm round bassline that weaves between the kick hits and locks into the chords.

step_by_step_walkthrough.title: Arrange the Warm Dynamic Journey
step_by_step_walkthrough.detail: Follow the locators: DJ Intro (32 bars), Chord Incline (32 bars), Main Groove (64 bars), Soul Breakdown (32 bars), Climax (64 bars), Outro (32 bars).

tracks.name: House Kick
tracks.annotation: Warm, round 909/808 kick. Gentle low-end punch.

tracks.name: Deep Bass
tracks.annotation: Warm FM Lately Bass or Juno square bass. Melodic groove.

tracks.name: Snare & Claps
tracks.annotation: Layered 909 clap and vintage snare on beats 2 and 4.

tracks.name: Rhodes / Keys
tracks.annotation: Soulful electric piano chords (min7, min9, min11).

tracks.name: Warm String Pad
tracks.annotation: Lush analog synth strings for emotional depth in breakdown.

tracks.name: Percussion & Congas
tracks.annotation: Live or sampled congas and shakers for human feel.

tracks.name: Vocal Hook / Chants
tracks.annotation: Soulful vocal sample with vintage plate reverb.

sections.name: DJ Intro (32 bars)
sections.description: Kick, congas, and swinging hats for smooth DJ blending.

sections.name: Chord Incline (32 bars)
sections.description: Bass enters along with subtle Rhodes chords and snare claps.

sections.name: Main Soul Groove (64 bars)
sections.description: Full warmth: complete bassline, lush keys, vocal hooks, and swinging percussion.

sections.name: Soul Breakdown (32 bars)
sections.description: Drums strip back; warm string pad and emotional Rhodes chords take center stage.

sections.name: Full Climax (64 bars)
sections.description: Drums kick back in with maximum soul and energy. All elements playing harmoniously.

sections.name: DJ Outro (32 bars)
sections.description: Chords fade out; kick, congas, and hats finish the track for easy mixing.
